column2: 這悖逆、污穢、欺壓的城有禍了！
column3: Woe to her who is rebellious and defiled, The tyrannical city!

column2: 他不聽從命令，不領受訓誨，不倚靠耶和華，不親近他的神。
column3: She heeded no voice, She accepted no instruction. She did not trust in the LORD, She did not draw near to her God.

column2: 他中間的首領是咆哮的獅子；他的審判官是晚上的豺狼，一點食物也不留到早晨。
column3: Her princes within her are roaring lions, Her judges are wolves at evening; They leave nothing for the morning.

column2: 他的先知是虛浮詭詐的人；他的祭司褻瀆聖所，強解律法。
column3: Her prophets are reckless, treacherous men; Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

column2: 耶和華在他中間是公義的，斷不做非義的事，每早晨顯明他的公義，無日不然；只是不義的人不知羞恥。
column3: The LORD is righteous within her; He will do no injustice. Every morning He brings His justice to light; He does not fail. But the unjust knows no shame.

column2: 我─耶和華已經除滅列國的民；他們的城樓毀壞。我使他們的街道荒涼，以致無人經過；他們的城邑毀滅，以致無人，也無居民。
column3: 'I have cut off nations; Their corner towers are in ruins. I have made their streets desolate, With no one passing by; Their cities are laid waste, Without a man, without an inhabitant.

column2: 我說：你只要敬畏我，領受訓誨；如此，你的住處不致照我所擬定的除滅。只是你們從早起來就在一切事上敗壞自己。
column3: 'I said, 'Surely you will revere Me, Accept instruction.' So her dwelling will not be cut off [According to] all that I have appointed concerning her. But they were eager to corrupt all their deeds.

column2: 耶和華說：你們要等候我，直到我興起擄掠的日子；因為我已定意招聚列國，聚集列邦，將我的惱怒─就是我的烈怒都傾在他們身上。我的忿怒如火，必燒滅全地。
column3: 'Therefore wait for Me,' declares the LORD, 'For the day when I rise up as a witness. Indeed, My decision is to gather nations, To assemble kingdoms, To pour out on them My indignation, All My burning anger; For all the earth will be devoured By the fire of My zeal.

column2: 那時，我必使萬民用清潔的言語好求告我─耶和華的名，同心合意地事奉我。
column3: 'For then I will give to the peoples purified lips, That all of them may call on the name of the LORD, To serve Him shoulder to shoulder.

column2: 祈禱我的，就是我所分散的民（原文是女子；下同），必從古實河外來，給我獻供物。
column3: 'From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia My worshipers, My dispersed ones, Will bring My offerings.

column2: 當那日，你必不因你一切得罪我的事自覺羞愧；因為那時我必從你中間除掉矜誇高傲之輩，你也不再於我的聖山狂傲。
column3: 'In that day you will feel no shame Because of all your deeds By which you have rebelled against Me; For then I will remove from your midst Your proud, exulting ones, And you will never again be haughty On My holy mountain.

column2: 我卻要在你中間留下困苦貧寒的民；他們必投靠我─耶和華的名。
column3: 'But I will leave among you A humble and lowly people, And they will take refuge in the name of the LORD.

column2: 以色列所剩下的人必不作罪孽，不說謊言，口中也沒有詭詐的舌頭；而且吃喝躺臥，無人驚嚇。
column3: 'The remnant of Israel will do no wrong And tell no lies, Nor will a deceitful tongue Be found in their mouths; For they will feed and lie down With no one to make them tremble.'

column2: 錫安的民哪，應當歌唱！以色列啊，應當歡呼！耶路撒冷的民哪，應當滿心歡喜快樂！
column3: Shout for joy, O daughter of Zion! Shout [in triumph], O Israel! Rejoice and exult with all [your] heart, O daughter of Jerusalem!

column2: 耶和華已經除去你的刑罰，趕出你的仇敵。以色列的王─耶和華在你中間；你必不再懼怕災禍。
column3: The LORD has taken away [His] judgments against you, He has cleared away your enemies. The King of Israel, the LORD, is in your midst; You will fear disaster no more.

column2: 當那日，必有話向耶路撒冷說：不要懼怕！錫安哪；不要手軟！
column3: In that day it will be said to Jerusalem: 'Do not be afraid, O Zion; Do not let your hands fall limp.

column2: 耶和華─你的神是施行拯救、大有能力的主。他在你中間必因你歡欣喜樂，默然愛你，且因你喜樂而歡呼。
column3: 'The LORD your God is in your midst, A victorious warrior. He will exult over you with joy, He will be quiet in His love, He will rejoice over you with shouts of joy.

column2: 那些屬你、為無大會愁煩、因你擔當羞辱的，我必聚集他們。
column3: 'I will gather those who grieve about the appointed feasts-- They came from you, [O Zion]; [The] reproach [of exile] is a burden on them.

column2: 那時，我必罰辦一切苦待你的人，又拯救你瘸腿的，聚集你被趕出的。那些在全地受羞辱的，我必使他們得稱讚，有名聲。
column3: 'Behold, I am going to deal at that time With all your oppressors, I will save the lame And gather the outcast, And I will turn their shame into praise and renown In all the earth.

column2: 那時，我必領你們進來，聚集你們；我使你們被擄之人歸回的時候，就必使你們在地上的萬民中有名聲，得稱讚。這是耶和華說的。
column3: 'At that time I will bring you in, Even at the time when I gather you together; Indeed, I will give you renown and praise Among all the peoples of the earth, When I restore your fortunes before your eyes,' Says the LORD.
